name: qween-ai-tools
description: QWEEN AI Tools — a collection of intelligent creative tools built for the QWEEN team. V1: Image Upscaler.

scripts.setup: npm run setup:backend && npm run setup:frontend
scripts.setup:backend: cd backend && { command -v python3.12 >/dev/null 2>&1 && python3.12 -m venv .venv || python3 -m venv .venv; } && ./.venv/bin/pip install --upgrade pip && ./.venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt
